{"code": "from numpy import sqrt

# Extract values from severity_groups
# Control group means, stds, counts
control_mild_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'mean'].values[0]
control_mild_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'std'].values[0]
control_mild_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'count'].values[0]

control_mod_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'mean'].values[0]
control_mod_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'std'].values[0]
control_mod_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'count'].values[0]

control_sev_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'mean'].values[0]
control_sev_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'std'].values[0]
control_sev_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'control'), 'count'].values[0]

# Treatment group means, stds, counts
treatment_mild_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'mean'].values[0]
treatment_mild_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'std'].values[0]
treatment_mild_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'mild') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'count'].values[0]

treatment_mod_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'mean'].values[0]
treatment_mod_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'std'].values[0]
treatment_mod_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'moderate') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'count'].values[0]

treatment_sev_mean = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'mean'].values[0]
treatment_sev_std = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'std'].values[0]
treatment_sev_n = severity_groups.loc[(severity_groups['severity'] == 'severe') & (severity_groups['arm'] == 'treatment'), 'count'].values[0]

# Compute differences within each severity group
diff_mild = treatment_mild_mean - control_mild_mean
diff_mod = treatment_mod_mean - control_mod_mean
diff_sev = treatment_sev_mean - control_sev_mean

# Compute weights based on control group size
control_total_n = control_mild_n + control_mod_n + control_sev_n
weight_mild = control_mild_n / control_total_n
weight_mod = control_mod_n / control_total_n
weight_sev = control_sev_n / control_total_n

# Compute adjusted mean difference
adjusted_diff = weight_mild * diff_mild + weight_mod * diff_mod + weight_sev * diff_sev

# Compute variance of the differences
var_mild = (treatment_mild_std**2 / treatment_mild_n) + (control_mild_std**2 / control_mild_n)
var_mod = (treatment_mod_std**2 / treatment_mod_n) + (control_mod_std**2 / control_mod_n)
var_sev = (treatment_sev_std**2 / treatment_sev_n) + (control_sev_std**2 / control_sev_n)

# Variance of the weighted sum
var_adj_diff = (weight_mild**2) * var_mild + (weight_mod**2) * var_mod + (weight_sev**2) * var_sev
se_adj_diff = sqrt(var_adj_diff)

# Compute z-statistic and p-value
z_stat = adjusted_diff / se_adj_diff
p_value = 2 * (1 - abs(2.71828**(-0.5 * z_stat**2)) / sqrt(2 * 3.14159))  # Approximate

# Print results
print(f"Adjusted mean difference (treatment - control): {adjusted_diff:.3f}")
print(f"Standard error: {se_adj_diff:.3f}")
print(f"z-statistic: {z_stat:.3f}")
print(f"p-value: {p_value:.4f}")"}
